extra.message: The fragment query parameter becomes executable template source in Template("Result: " + fragment).render(). extra.message: The packet_ref query parameter is joined directly to incoming_dir and passed to write_bytes(). Absolute paths or ../ segments escape the intended directory. extra.message: The request's filter object, or its entire JSON body, is passed directly to MongoDB find_one(). extra.message: Every imported customer account receives the same hardcoded password, Imported123!, and is active by default. Anyone who knows an imported email address can authenticate with this public constant and access that customer's organization tickets and attachments. No forced password-change mechanism is implemented.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Publishing permission is checked only when the submitted status equals published. A support agent can omit status and modify the body or title of an already published article, immediately exposing unreviewed content to customers. The same bypass permits changing a published internal article's visibility to customer without administrator or team-lead approval.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: Authorization checks only whether staff can work the ticket before applying changes. A support agent can then supply arbitrary existing team_id, queue_id, and assigned_agent_id values, transferring tickets across team boundaries or assigning other users without a team-lead/admin permission check or validation of the destination's scope.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: Posting a public message as a customer unconditionally changes the ticket status to open. This bypasses allowed_transition(), which permits customer reopening only from pending_customer or resolved. Customers can therefore reopen closed tickets or clear escalated and pending_internal states on their organization's tickets through the messages endpoint.

cwe: CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow

extra.message: CSV exports write customer-controlled ticket subjects and organization names without neutralizing spreadsheet formulas. A customer can submit a value beginning with =, +, -, or @ that is exported unchanged. Opening the report in a spreadsheet can interpret the value as a formula, enabling deceptive content or external requests depending on the spreadsheet application.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: Attachment uploads copy the complete supplied file to persistent storage without checking its size or enforcing a user or organization quota. A self-registered customer can create a ticket and upload oversized or repeated attachments until the application's filesystem is exhausted.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: The login endpoint accepts unlimited password attempts without account lockout, backoff, or request throttling. Failed authentication immediately returns and records no attempt counter. Remote callers can repeatedly guess passwords or perform credential stuffing against known account addresses.

cwe: CWE-307: Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts

extra.message: The lane query parameter is passed directly to RedirectResponse without restricting it to local destinations. Requests satisfying the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN gate can produce redirects to attacker-controlled absolute or scheme-relative URLs.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

extra.message: The operations tally handler writes the complete Authorization header and request body to warning-level logs. Any bearer credential or confidential body submitted by an authenticated operations client is exposed to log readers and retained by logging systems without redaction.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: The count query parameter controls an eagerly constructed list of dictionaries without an upper bound. A caller holding the INTERNAL_OPS_TOKEN can request an enormous count, exhausting memory and blocking the event loop while the async handler allocates and serializes the result.

extra.message: The length query parameter controls random character generation and string construction without a maximum.
